content: अभिभूति {%a.%} That which defeats, conquers <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-तिः@} .²1 Predominance, prevalence, excessive or superior power; जूतिं कृष्टिप्रो अभिभूतिमाशोः <ls>Rv. 4. 38. 9</ls>. .²2 Conquering, defeat, subjugation; अभिभूतिभयादसूनतः सुखमुज्झन्ति न धाम मानिनः <ls>Ki. 2. 20</ls>. .²3 Disrespect, disgrace, humiliation.
